original_reproduction.scenario: New fictionally signed document whose occurredAt predates an already revoked signer key
original_reproduction.observed_after_revocation: HTTP 200, replay:false, accepted despite already revoked signer

repair.change: On new signed record admission, reject if current admission time is at/after revocation or expiry. Keep existing exact signed record replay idempotent.

known_open_gap.name: DIRECT_OWNER_SQL_CAN_BYPASS_ED25519_APPLICATION_VERIFICATION
known_open_gap.root_cause: QA application connection and financial table ownership both use neondb_owner. PostgreSQL pgcrypto alone cannot verify Ed25519 and pgsodium/plv8 are unavailable. Database trigger checks economics but not cryptographic signature.
known_open_gap.security_consequence: A database writer with owner-level INSERT can construct apparently valid fictional records with an invalid Ed25519 signature, bypassing HTTP verification.
known_open_gap.remediation_needed: Provision independently controlled signing-verifier service and limited database writer credentials with audited admission/proof boundary. Must re-run app and SQL tests with actual restricted runtime credential.
